Reported by NeoTeo: Norwegian media seek court pause on Meta AI terms.
Reported by The Herald Journal: AI Safety.
Reported by Crypto Briefing: Trump flags imported robotics as a national security risk, holds off on tariffs.
Confirmed, per FOX 7 Austin: Pflugerville City Council passes SAFE Act to regulate AI, surveillance.
